newsitem.title: USA: Starwood Lodging acquires San Diego hotel.
newsitem.headline: Starwood Lodging acquires San Diego hotel.

text.p: Starwood Lodging Trust on Thursday said it has acquired a 264-room hotel, the Marriott Suites Hotel, in downtown San Diego for $32.5 million, or about $123,000 per room.
Starwood said the purchase was made for about 80 percent of replacement cost. The 27-story San Diego hotel joins Starwood's four other hotels in southern California.
The franchised Marriott hotel was owned by privately held DIA Pacific Development Corp.
In addition to the single hotel, Starwood said it will continue considering and evaluating possible acquisitions of branded hotel companies or the development of its own brand.

"Any transaction we pursue with a brand must be materially accretive in management's best estimates to Starwood Lodging's shareholders not only in its second year, but also in the first year of our operations," Barry Sternlicht, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
